hook: Be the business your neighbors read about.
intro: ExploreNation is a local magazine for Las Vegas and Henderson, launching soon, that focuses on positive, true stories about local people and places. Put your business in front of locals who are looking for places to go and people to support.

why.title: Locals want to know what's good near them.
paragraphs: People will open ExploreNation to find good things in their own city. That's where your business shows up.
ExploreNation has five areas, LIVE, WORK, EXPLORE, SERVE and BUILD, each split into topics like neighborhoods, things to do and small business. Your business shows up where it fits.

options.title: Three ways to be part of it

items.label: Free listing
items.title: Be easy to find
items.text: Create a free account and add your business, so locals can find you by what you do and how to reach you. Paid upgrades are available.

image.alt: A sample free listing for a family law firm, with its name, specialty, town and phone number

items.label: Partner spot
items.title: Own your trade
items.text: Each section has six partner spots, one per trade. Yours shows on every story in that section, and no competitor can take it. Your partner card is made from your listing, so there's nothing to design. You also get our content studio in your dashboard, where you make your own short videos, pictures and flyers.

image.alt: A sample paid partner card for a pediatrician, shown between paragraphs of a story

items.label: Sponsored feature
items.title: Get your story told
items.text: Our staff writes a story about your business, always clearly labeled as sponsored, so readers get to know the people behind it.

image.alt: A sample sponsored feature titled Keeping pets calm through Henderson's noisy holidays, with a yellow Sponsored by label

soon.label: Also planned: print
soon.text: A printed magazine is planned, six times a year, with paid full-page Partner Profiles and cover ads. It's sold on its own, and the founding-rate code doesn't cover it. Ask on your free call.

story.title: Many stories are reported by young people from your city
paragraphs: Many of the magazine's regular stories are reported by local young people, NowTRANSFORMED Ambassadors, learning to interview, write and take photos with coaching. Their name goes on their work, so every story helps them build a real portfolio.
Sponsored features are different: our staff writes them, and they're always labeled.

sponsorship.title: You may qualify for a NowTRANSFORMED sponsorship
sponsorship.text: If you're a good fit, the NowTRANSFORMED team gives you a code for ExploreNation's founding rate, a lower price than the regular rate. The founding rate is only available with a code. We'll go over it on your free call.

steps.title: Tell us who you are
steps.text: Your name and email, then pick a time.

steps.title: Free 15-minute call
steps.text: The NowTRANSFORMED team walks you through the options and rates, and checks whether you qualify for a sponsorship.

steps.title: Pick what fits
steps.text: Qualify, and you get your founding-rate code. Choose a listing, a partner spot or a feature, and you're there from launch day.

faqs.a: A basic listing is free. Partner spots and sponsored features have regular rates. If you qualify for a NowTRANSFORMED sponsorship, you get a code for ExploreNation's lower founding rate. You'll get exact numbers on the free call.
The team asks what you're looking for, explains how ExploreNation works and answers your questions. There's no obligation to sign up.
Not yet. It's launching soon in Las Vegas and Henderson. Businesses that join now are there from day one and get first pick of the partner spots.

faqs.q: Will there be a printed magazine?
faqs.a: One is planned, six times a year. You could buy a Partner Profile: a full page on your business, written and photographed by ExploreNation, one business per trade per issue. It would also run online as a story with a QR code and a short video interview. Cover ads are planned too. Print is sold on its own, not with a partner spot, and the founding-rate code doesn't cover it. Ask on your free call.
We focus on positive, true stories about local people and places. Anything paid is always clearly labeled, so readers can trust the rest.

faqs.q: Do I need to design an ad?
faqs.a: No. Your partner card is made from your listing, so there's nothing to design.

It's a tool in your dashboard to make your own marketing. Record a short video on your phone, or turn your photos into one. Captions go on automatically and the ums get tidied out. You can also design pictures and flyers. You download it all and post it yourself. It comes with the partner spot and the bigger monthly packages, even at the founding rate. It isn't part of the free listing or a one-off sponsored story. It'll be there when ExploreNation launches.

closing.title: Get your business into the good news.
closing.text: A free 15-minute call. Pick a time that works for you.
